# VIZ.RENDER.LOD.CACHE: GPU chunk cache and out-of-core streaming source

## Purpose

Keep the chunks the traversal wants on the GPU without exceeding a memory budget: an LRU cache of uploaded chunk buffers bounded by a fraction of reported device memory, fed asynchronously from `GEO.OOC.LOD` so the frame never blocks on disk, and exposed to the traversal as a `ChunkHierarchy` whose resident flags reflect what is on the GPU.

## Scope

**In:** `GpuChunkCache`; budget from device memory; LRU eviction with pinning of chunks drawn this frame; async load queue with a per-frame upload cap; adapter implementing `ChunkHierarchy` over `GEO.OOC.LOD`.
**Out:** traversal (`VIZ.RENDER.LOD.TRAV`); octree layout and chunk storage (`GEO.OOC.LAYOUT`, `GEO.OOC.CACHE`); point raster (`VIZ.RENDER.LOD.RASTER`).

## Requirements

- **REQ-VIZ.RENDER.LOD.CACHE-001** The cache shall be bounded by a configurable fraction of reported device memory, default 70 % [unverified], and shall never hold more bytes than that bound.
- **REQ-VIZ.RENDER.LOD.CACHE-002** When the bound would be exceeded, the cache shall evict least-recently-drawn chunks first and shall never evict a chunk drawn in the current frame.
- **REQ-VIZ.RENDER.LOD.CACHE-003** Chunk loads shall run off the render thread, and the cache shall upload at most a configurable number of bytes per frame (default 64 MiB [unverified]).
- **REQ-VIZ.RENDER.LOD.CACHE-004** If a chunk fails to load or fails its digest check in GEO, then the cache shall mark it unavailable, keep drawing its resident ancestor and report the chunk ID once in diagnostics.

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC-1** Given fixture `fixtures/viz/cloud-ooc-50m` (a 5 × 10^7-point GEO.OOC layout, seed 37) and a fake device reporting 256 MiB, when a scripted 60 s fly-through runs on the software adapter, then cache bytes never exceed 179.2 MiB (70 %).
- **AC-2** Given the same run, then no chunk drawn in a frame is evicted during that frame (checked by an eviction log).
- **AC-3** Given a chunk file corrupted in the fixture, then the run continues, its ancestor is drawn and diagnostics name the chunk once.
- **AC-4** Given an upload cap of 8 MiB, then no frame uploads more than 8 MiB.

## Design

- **Registry command(s):** none; library. Settings `viz.render.gpu_mem_fraction` and `viz.render.upload_per_frame` via `CORE.STO.SET`.
- **Data structures:** `GpuChunkCache { budget_bytes, entries: BTreeMap<ChunkId, Entry>, lru: IndexedList }`; `OocHierarchy` implementing `ChunkHierarchy` over `GEO.OOC.LOD`.
- **Algorithm:** traversal requests → enqueue missing chunks by SSE priority → worker threads read LOD subsets → upload under per-frame cap → mark resident; evict LRU unpinned until under budget.
- **Errors:** `ChunkUnavailable` (diagnostic), `DeviceLost` (forwarded).
- **Determinism:** N (timing-dependent residency; the drawn data of a resident chunk is deterministic).
- **Performance budget:** no frame stall above 33 ms due to loading on the reference profile [unverified].
- **Crate:** `fid-render` (module `lod::cache`).

## Test fixtures

`fixtures/viz/cloud-ooc-50m`: generated by a seeded script (seed 37) into GEO.OOC layout at test time, not stored; a fake device-memory shim.

## Build prompt

> In crate `fid-render`, add module `lod::cache`: a GPU chunk cache bounded by `viz.render.gpu_mem_fraction` (default 0.70) of reported device memory, LRU eviction that never evicts chunks drawn this frame, off-thread loading from `GEO.OOC.LOD` with a per-frame upload cap (`viz.render.upload_per_frame`, default 64 MiB), and `OocHierarchy` implementing the `ChunkHierarchy` trait from `lod::trav` with resident flags. Failed or digest-mismatched chunks become unavailable and the ancestor keeps drawing. Tests AC-1..AC-4 with a generated `cloud-ooc-50m` (seed 37) and a fake memory shim. Rules: CONSTITUTION §8; C2; no std HashMap.
